policy: Bundle data when redistribution is clearly licensed. Otherwise fetch public/freeware/shareware/demo data from the recorded upstream/public source and stage it locally without committing it to source control.

freedoom-0.13.0.notes: Freedoom is free content intended for Doom-compatible engines.

cave-story-english-1006.notes: Pre-extracted NXEngine-compatible data mirror for the original freeware Cave Story. The fetcher records the observed SHA-256; do not commit or republish this archive from AmigaChrome.

omf2097-assets.notes: This is the data archive linked directly by OpenOMF upstream BUILD.md. Record the observed SHA-256 after fetch until a publisher checksum is pinned.

jazz-shareware-1.1.notes: Shareware episode only. Never substitute or bundle registered/full Jazz Jackrabbit data.

pop1-demo.notes: Two-level Prince of Persia demo reference dataset. SDLPoP source also carries its own project runtime data.
